rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
reason: Tiga percobaan total tidak lolos Sangar. Bentuk terdokumentasi hanya hewan seperti harimau/macan tutul yang lebih kecil (c03/c05). Dua koreksi memperlihatkan konfrontasi pada induk (c02/c05) tanpa gore, tetapi pada200px tetap terbaca anak harimau biasa memanjat/bermain dengan induknya. Tidak menambah anatomi atau kuasa rekaan dan tidak meluluskan gambar gagal.

visual_requirements.description: Small tiger-like beast with one head, two eyes, four paws and one tail; much larger same-kind parent behind.
Young beast violently turns against its parent, represented by hostile leap at parent's throat without contact injury, blood or consumption.
Chinese legendary context; neutral dark ground because no precise habitat documented.

artistic_choices: Tried documented confrontation with much larger parent; no blood, wounds, eating, invented powers or changed anatomy.
Native and200px viewed. No image selected: Sangar2 and7 remain failed.

rejected_attempts.reason: Reads as an ordinary tiger cub lunging on bare ground — the 'ordinary animal' failure. 'Like a tiger or leopard but smaller' [wd-q10441691-c03, c05] is the whole documented form, so the picture has to come from the story instead: the jing is the beast that turns on its own parent as soon as it is born or grown [c02, c05]. Show the small tiger-like beast confronting a far larger parent of its kind whose looming body fills the background, the young one's stance unmistakably hostile; no blood, wounds or eating. If no composition reads without gore, mark it tidak-digambar with that reason.
Small tiger cub confronting parent visible, but round startled parental eyes and juvenile proportions read as ordinary animal play; Sangar2/7 fail.

Final targeted attempt adds throat-directed claws and mature proportions; at200px still reads as tiger cub climbing parent. Sangar2/7 fail; cannot distinguish myth's cruelty without gore or invented anatomy.
